summary: Frontend testing of the 'Train Someone Next' invite feature. Logged in as test_invite@example.com. All 6 requested checks pass after one mobile layout fix made by the testing agent. On desktop the button sits to the right of download-scorecard-button on the same row, and both buttons are visible at 390px. invite-message matches the required text exactly, ending with <origin>/register?ref=6ad2a2bc8e3ed898398d3aac. Copy Link puts the exact URL on the clipboard and shows the 'Invite link copied' toast. The SMS href starts with 'sms:?&body=' and the email href starts with 'mailto:?subject='; both bodies decode to the exact message. The modal closes with both X and Escape. One referral signup through the UI (TEST_ref_64059@example.com) went to /welcome, and db.users stored referred_by='6ad2a2bc8e3ed898398d3aac'. Bug found and fixed: on 390px mobile the modal content overflowed horizontally (scrollWidth 591 vs clientWidth 388), so the title was clipped and the Email share button sat off-screen at x=411. The cause was the truncated (nowrap) invite-link row: as a child of the DialogContent grid with min-width:auto it forced the column wider. Adding min-w-0 to that row and its span fixed it (scrollWidth now 388 and all 3 share buttons visible). Cleanup: deleted 2 test users (/^test/i) and their 7 progress docs.

minor.issue: referred_by is accepted as any string up to 64 characters and is not checked against an existing user id. Low risk, but bad or garbage referral data can be stored.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: the invite-link row with truncate/whitespace-nowrap overflowed the dialog grid, clipping the title and pushing the Email share button off-screen. Added min-w-0 to the link wrapper div and span.

issues: 'Train Someone Next' is styled as a small underlined text link (26px tall), while the download button is a solid gold 48px button. The spec asks for a 'highly visible' item, so consider an outlined gold button of the same height as the download button.

action_items: Optional: make train-someone-next-button a more prominent outlined button so it meets the 'highly visible' requirement
Optional: validate referred_by on register (must be a valid ObjectId of an existing user)
critical_code_review_comments: TrainSomeoneNext reads user.id with no null guard. That is fine because the page is protected, but the component would crash if it were reused outside auth.
Register.jsx still has a debug console.log for marketing_opt_in
test_credentials: test_invite@example.com / test1234 was seeded by the main agent and has now been DELETED during cleanup as instructed (all /^test/i users removed). Re-seed it if retesting is needed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Invite feature verified end-to-end. Mobile overflow fix is in TrainSomeoneNext.jsx (min-w-0). The test_invite user was deleted, so re-seed it to retest.
rca of the issue: Mobile overflow: DialogContent is display:grid. Grid items default to min-width:auto, so the nowrap/truncate link span set the min-content width (~590px) of the single 1fr column, and the whole modal grew wider than the viewport. Fix: min-w-0 on the flex row and the span lets the text truncate.
